pages.text:
昨天放学的时候，李老师蹲下来，笑眯眯地对咘咘说："咘咘，明天轮到你当值日生啦！"
咘咘的眼睛一下子亮了。值日生！那可是只有特别特别棒的小朋友才能当的！
pages.text_en:
Yesterday after school, Teacher Li knelt down and said with a smile, "Bubu, tomorrow is your turn to be the greeter!"
Bubu's eyes lit up at once. The greeter! Only the very best kids get to do that!

pages.text:
晚上睡觉前，咘咘在床上翻来翻去，兴奋得睡不着。
"NOMI，明天我要当值日生！我要站在门口跟大家说早上好！"
NOMI帮她盖好被子："那你得早早睡觉，明天才有精神呀。"
咘咘乖乖闭上眼睛，嘴角偷偷翘着。
pages.text_en:
That night before bed, Bubu tossed and turned, too excited to sleep.
"NOMI, tomorrow I'll be the greeter! I'll stand at the door and say good morning to everyone!"
NOMI tucked her in. "Then you need to sleep early, so you'll have energy tomorrow."
Bubu obediently closed her eyes, the corner of her mouth secretly curling up.

pages.text:
第二天一大早，咘咘自己睁开眼睛，一骨碌从床上爬起来。
平时她总要赖一会儿，可今天不一样——她是值日生！
"我要自己起来！"咘咘小声给自己加油。
pages.text_en:
The next morning, Bubu opened her eyes on her own and scrambled out of bed.
Usually she'd linger a while, but today was different — she was the greeter!
"I'm going to get up by myself!" Bubu whispered, cheering herself on.

pages.text:
咘咘跑到洗手间，踩上小板凳，自己挤好牙膏，认认真真地刷牙。
"上面刷刷，下面刷刷，里面也要刷到哦。"
刷完牙，她用小毛巾把脸擦得干干净净。
pages.text_en:
Bubu ran to the bathroom, stepped on her little stool, squeezed the toothpaste, and brushed her teeth carefully.
"Brush the top, brush the bottom, don't forget the inside."
After brushing, she wiped her face clean with a small towel.

pages.text:
奶奶走过来想帮她穿衣服，咘咘摇摇头："我自己来！"
她拿起幼儿园的小园服，先套头，再伸胳膊，虽然有一下穿反了，但她自己翻过来重新穿好了。
奶奶在旁边笑着竖起大拇指。
pages.text_en:
Grandma came to help her get dressed, but Bubu shook her head. "I'll do it myself!"
She picked up her kindergarten uniform, pulled it over her head, then put her arms through. She got it backwards once, but flipped it around and put it on right.
Grandma smiled and gave her a thumbs up.

pages.text:
早饭桌上，爷爷已经摆好了粥和鸡蛋。咘咘今天吃得特别快，一口粥一口蛋，还把碗里的粥喝得干干净净。
"今天怎么这么乖呀？"爸爸笑着问。
"因为我是值日生！值日生不能迟到！"咘咘认真地说。
pages.text_en:
At the breakfast table, Grandpa had already set out porridge and eggs. Bubu ate especially fast today, alternating between porridge and egg, finishing every last drop.
"Why so good today?" Dad asked with a smile.
"Because I'm the greeter! Greeters can't be late!" Bubu said seriously.

pages.text:
爸爸帮咘咘背上小书包，爷爷在门口换好了鞋。
"走吧，我们的小值日生！"爸爸牵起咘咘的左手，爷爷牵起她的右手。
一家人出了门，阳光暖暖地洒在路上。
pages.text_en:
Dad helped Bubu put on her little backpack, and Grandpa changed into his shoes at the door.
"Let's go, our little greeter!" Dad held Bubu's left hand, Grandpa held her right.
The family walked out the door, warm sunlight spilling onto the road.

pages.text:
到了幼儿园门口，李老师已经在等她了。
"咘咘来啦！今天你是我们的小值日生，准备好了吗？"
咘咘用力点头："准备好了！"
爸爸和爷爷蹲下来，一人亲了她一边脸颊："加油哦！"
pages.text_en:
At the kindergarten gate, Teacher Li was already waiting.
"Bubu is here! You're our little greeter today. Are you ready?"
Bubu nodded hard. "Ready!"
Dad and Grandpa both knelt down and each kissed one of her cheeks. "You can do it!"

pages.text:
李老师帮咘咘在胸前别上一个小小的"值日生"徽章，金色的，亮闪闪的。
咘咘低头看了看，觉得自己好威风。
她站直了身子，双手放在身前，就像老师教的那样。
pages.text_en:
Teacher Li pinned a small golden "Greeter" badge on Bubu's chest, shiny and bright.
Bubu looked down at it and felt so proud.
She stood up straight with her hands in front, just like Teacher had shown her.

pages.text:
第一个到的是甘老师，推着自行车走进来。
咘咘深吸一口气，大声说："甘老师，早上好！"
甘老师笑得眼睛弯弯的："早上好，咘咘！今天好精神呀！"
pages.text_en:
The first to arrive was Teacher Gan, pushing her bicycle in.
Bubu took a deep breath and said loudly, "Good morning, Teacher Gan!"
Teacher Gan smiled with her eyes curved. "Good morning, Bubu! You look so spirited today!"

pages.text:
接着，小朋友们一个一个来了。
"同学，早上好！"——小熊同学来了。
"早上好！"——小猫同学蹦蹦跳跳地跑过来。
"哥哥早上好！"——大班的哥哥姐姐也经过门口。
咘咘一个一个地打招呼，声音从小小的，变得越来越响亮。
pages.text_en:
Then, the children arrived one by one.
"Good morning!" — Little Bear arrived.
"Good morning!" — Little Cat bounced over.
"Good morning, big brother!" — The older kids walked past.
Bubu greeted each one, her voice growing louder and louder.

pages.text:
有一个小朋友走到门口，有点害羞，低着头不说话。
咘咘想了想，弯下腰，轻轻地说："早上好呀，不用害怕的。"
那个小朋友抬起头，小声说了一句："早上好。"然后笑了。
咘咘觉得心里暖暖的。
pages.text_en:
One little friend came to the door, shy and looking down without speaking.
Bubu thought for a moment, leaned forward, and said softly, "Good morning. Don't be scared."
The little friend looked up and whispered, "Good morning." Then smiled.
Bubu felt warm inside.

pages.text:
所有人都到齐了。李老师走过来，在咘咘头上贴了一颗小星星贴纸。
"咘咘今天做得特别棒！声音响亮，还会照顾害羞的小朋友，是最好的值日生！"
咘咘摸着头上的星星，笑得露出了小白牙。
pages.text_en:
Everyone had arrived. Teacher Li came over and put a little star sticker on Bubu's head.
"Bubu did an amazing job today! Loud voice, and you even took care of the shy friend. You're the best greeter!"
Bubu touched the star on her head and smiled, showing her little white teeth.

pages.text:
放学的时候，爸爸来接咘咘。
咘咘飞快地跑过去，扑到爸爸怀里："爸爸！我今天当值日生了！我跟每个人都说了早上好！"
"我知道，老师发了照片给我看，"爸爸把她举高高，"我们家咘咘太厉害了！"
pages.text_en:
At pickup time, Dad came to get Bubu.
Bubu ran over and jumped into his arms. "Dad! I was the greeter today! I said good morning to everyone!"
"I know, Teacher sent me photos," Dad lifted her high up. "Our Bubu is amazing!"

pages.text:
晚上，咘咘把金色的值日生徽章放在枕头旁边。
NOMI问："下次还想当值日生吗？"
"想！"咘咘用力点头，"下次我要声音更大，让所有人都开开心心地进幼儿园！"
NOMI笑着关上小夜灯："晚安，最棒的小值日生。"
pages.text_en:
That night, Bubu placed the golden greeter badge next to her pillow.
NOMI asked, "Do you want to be the greeter again next time?"
"Yes!" Bubu nodded hard. "Next time I'll be even louder, so everyone walks into kindergarten happy!"
NOMI smiled and turned off the nightlight. "Good night, best little greeter."
